blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Justice (DOJ) has filed a petition for the extradition of Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) leader Apollo Carreon Quiboloy and two of his co-accused before the Makati Regional Trial Court. In a statement Tuesday, the DOJ said the petition for extradition has been assigned before Makati RTC Branch 145.
